description: NHC working best track of Hurricane Melissa (AL132025): 45 six-hourly centre positions from 2025-10-21 06 UTC to 2025-11-01 06 UTC with intensity (INTENSITY, kt), minimum pressure (MSLP, mb), Saffir-Simpson category and storm type. Post-storm smoothed positions; they differ from the real-time advisories. Derived column valid_time (UTC) from DTG.

table:columns.name: STORMNAME
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): storm name; 'INVEST' on the first (pre-genesis) row, 'MELISSA' on the other 44.

table:columns.name: DTG
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The valid date and time of the data in UTC' as a number YYYYMMDDHH, e.g. 2025102812; parsed into valid_time.

table:columns.name: MONTH
table:columns.description: Month of DTG (UTC), text as shipped by NHC.

table:columns.name: HHMM
table:columns.description: Hour and minute of DTG (UTC), text as shipped by NHC.

table:columns.name: MSLP
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'the estimated sea level pressure at the center of a tropical cyclone (the lowest pressure in the system in Millibars)'; 892 to 1003 mb here.

table:columns.name: BASIN
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The ocean where the tropical cyclone is located'; AL = Atlantic.

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): sequential number of the cyclone in the basin (13).

table:columns.name: STORMTYPE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The category of the tropical cyclone': TS Tropical Storm (18 rows), HU Hurricane (23), EX Extratropical (4, from 2025-10-31 12 UTC).

table:columns.name: INTENSITY
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'the highest 1-minute average wind (at an elevation of 10 meters ...) associated with a tropical cyclone at a particular point in time (knots)'. Best-track maximum sustained wind, 40 to 165 kt.

table:columns.name: SS
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The Saffir Simpson Hurricane Scale ... 1-5 rating based on the hurricane's present intensity' (0 = below hurricane strength). Rows: 0 = 22, 1 = 5, 2 = 5, 3 = 3, 4 = 4, 5 = 6.

table:columns.name: LAT
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): latitude of the centre, decimal degrees (0.1 deg), 14.0 to 46.6; duplicates the geometry.

table:columns.name: LON
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): longitude of the centre, decimal degrees, negative west, -78.6 to -51.3; duplicates the geometry.

table:columns.name: valid_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): DTG parsed to UTC; 2025-10-21 06:00 to 2025-11-01 06:00 UTC in 6-h steps, 45 rows.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Centre position (Point, 0.1 deg) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file); coordinates as shipped by NHC, not transformed.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
